transcript.content: Hi — before we begin, I want to be transparent: you're chatting with an AI assistant, not a human agent. I can help with your subscription and answer account questions. If anything needs a person, I'll hand you to one.
Your price is getting hard to justify. I want to cancel.

Thanks for the candor. If cost is the blocker, I can pause your subscription for up to 3 months at no charge so you're not paying while you reassess — your data and settings stay intact. Would you like the pause, or should I proceed with cancellation?
A 3-month pause works — please set that up.
Done — your plan is paused for 3 months and you won't be billed during that time. You'll get a confirmation email shortly. Anything else I can help with?
